title: Official Code of Georgia Annotated, Title 47 (Retirement and Pensions), Chapter 2 — Employees' Retirement System of Georgia
verified_how: read the register's own table of contents in a browser: 'TITLE 47 Retirement and Pensions (Chs. 1 — 25)' expanded to 'CHAPTER 2 Employees' Retirement System of Georgia (Arts. 1 — 10)', listed live alongside Chapters 3-25 for other systems.
notes: in_force 'unclear' for the same CAPTCHA reason. Georgia has no auto-IRA for private-sector workers. Title 47 Chapter 18 separately governs Social Security coverage agreements for state and local employees; old-age and survivors insurance itself is federal (42 U.S.C. ch. 7).
